shapeAndRegistrationPreservation.note: The finished character appropriately replaces the primitive silhouette. The opaque pelvis attachment and absence of a finished neutral standing view prevent a confident nominal standing-scale/root judgment; primitive outlines, hair height and toe bounds alone cannot settle it. Keep this observation separate from the successful creative refinement and from the frozen geometry rubric.
